posts.title: Engineering Fought Productivity Metrics. AI Ended the Fight.
posts.description: Uber spent its entire 2026 AI token budget in four months. Salesforce’s Anthropic bill is reportedly running around $300 million a year. Meta employees built an internal leaderboard that ranked roughly 85,000 people by token consumption and logged more than 60 trillion tokens in a single month.

posts.title: The Lighthouse and the Lifeboat
posts.description: In 2001, Nelson Repenning and John Sterman published a paper in the California Management Review with one of the best titles in management writing: “Nobody Ever Gets Credit for Fixing Problems that Never Happened.”

posts.title: The Laziness Loophole: How Human Shortcuts Become AI Autonomy
posts.description: AI is moving from answering to doing. It used to draft your email. Now it can send it, negotiate your car, book your travel, and push your code. When AI only produced text, a paragraph you didn’t read cost you a bad email or a wrong fact. When AI takes action, the paragraph you didn’t read can cost a lot more.
